scope: Read-only audit of Beads documentation/assets and Grainfield control, rights, geometry, and procedural-knob acceptance gates.

files_reviewed.relevance: straight-on physical knob and pointer reference; reference-only

documentation_review.finding: Documentation establishes control-family behavior and labels but supplies no machine-readable correspondence from DXF handles to physical controls.

geometry_placement.rights_boundary: AI/PDF artwork remains external and is not redistributed

authoritative_control_mapping.reason: DXF contains geometry and handles but no labels, net IDs, component references, or export manifest tying the 19 auxiliary/small entities to source semantics. Source processing order and visual proximity are insufficient evidence.

rights_cleared_reference.finding: Panel artwork, AI/DXF-derived artwork, and physical reference images remain outside the repository and pending rights/share-alike/trademark review. No redistribution or release fidelity claim is authorized.

procedural_knob_visual_acceptance.finding: The v2 procedural target models a black segmented annulus, off-white cap, and broad pointer, but existing knob audit/capture receipts are bound to earlier heads and full-panel pixel comparison is explicitly not run.

decision: No control binding or visual-release claim is made. Existing geometry evidence is retained as placement-only; all ambiguous controls remain provisional.
required_next_evidence: Rights-cleared straight-on panel/reference or an explicit permission and share-alike decision.
Design-tool export manifest or PCB/panel component map with control labels/source IDs and DXF coordinates.
Fresh exact-head full-panel render and normalized pixel/geometry comparison after rights clearance.
Fresh exact-head deterministic min/mid/max knob renders and acceptance receipt.
negative_controls: Do not assign aux-* or small-* entities by DXF order, source enum order, visual proximity, or screenshot guess.
Do not embed or redistribute Beads panel artwork, AI/PDF, CAD, or reference photos before rights review.
Do not call procedural knob calibration release-faithful while exact-head full-panel comparison is absent.
